name: Hyoscine-N-butylbromide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 10 to 20 mg per dose; for prolonged illness 10 mg three to five times daily; maximum 60 mg/day
10 to 20 mg by slow IV (1 mL/min), IM or SC injection; maximum 100 mg/day

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other anticholinergics (tricyclic antidepressants, antipsychotics, antihistamines, quinidine, disopyramide, amantadine), MAO inhibitors

key_interactions.action: Use IV or SC instead of IM.

serious: Anaphylaxis and anaphylactic shock, including fatal cases (mainly after injection)
Hypotension and tachycardia after injection in heart disease

contraindications: Myasthenia gravis; megacolon; mechanical gastrointestinal stenosis; paralytic or obstructive ileus
monitoring: Heart rate and blood pressure after injection

pk.half_life: About 5 hours (IV terminal); 6.2 to 10.6 hours after high oral doses
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 50% unchanged in urine after IV; under 0.1% after oral dosing (90% in feces)

sources.citation: Sanofi Consumer Health Inc. (2021). Buscopan (hyoscine butylbromide) tablets 10 mg and injection 20 mg/mL [Prescribing information; revised March 31, 2021]. Health Canada Drug Product Database.
